name: swallowed-assertion-exit-zero
source: try { const assert = require('assert'); assert(false); } catch (e) {} process.exit(0);

name: review-scoped-assert-binding
source: function unused() { const assert = require('assert'); }; function assert() {}; assert(false);

name: review-bracket-process-exit-override
source: process['exit'] = () => {}; const ok = false; if (!ok) process.exit(1);

name: review-unreachable-conditional-exit
source: const actual = { ok: false }; if (false && actual.ok) process.exit(1);

name: review-derived-shadowed-assert
source: const assert = require('assert'); const ok = true; if (ok) { const assert = () => {}; assert(false); }

name: review-derived-aliased-assert-mutation
source: const assert = require('assert'); const alias = assert; alias.equal = () => {}; assert.equal(1, 2);
